confirmed_from_user_error_text.error: Cannot call property uuid in object ServerPlayer; it is not a function, it is object
confirmed_from_user_error_text.cause: The installed local edit calls uuid() although KubeJS exposes a UUID bean property. The repository v0.3 instead calls getUUID(), which is also not exposed under that name.
Rhino cannot choose primitive long versus boxed Long and bridge Object overloads. Explicit Long.valueOf(String) also remains ambiguous in real build.85.

confirmed_from_pinned_source: EntityMixin remaps getUUID() to getUuid(); its bean property uuid is an object.
